name: FastH3-Omni — seamless looping video with sound (8 steps)
description:
The same seamless loop as the MiniMax H3 loop card, made with FastVideo's FastH3-Omni, a version of H3 distilled to 8 steps. The last frame flows straight back into the first, sound included, and the whole loop is smoothed with frame interpolation.

The author finds it close to the 25-step look WITH a reference picture (a bit punchier), while text-only prompts give a different shot. It can judder slightly on fast motion; slow flows stay smooth. Good for drafts.

Write the prompt as a state that keeps going: a locked-off camera, one large subject doing one cyclic thing, steady light and a steady overall_soundscape — no timelines, no one-off events, nothing that piles up. Upload a picture and call it <Picture 1> to hold the subject and look. Try several seeds.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 Loop — prompting guide
promptGuides.tip: Describe a state that keeps going, not a sequence of events: locked-off camera, one subject doing one cyclic thing, steady light and sound. Ask: if this played twice in a row, would the joint show?

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 Loop — the node pack

author: pxl-pshr (ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Loop)

models.note: Fetched by ComfyUI-Frame-Interpolation into its own ckpts/film folder on first use.

exposedParameters.label: Prompt — a state that keeps going, not a sequence of events
exposedParameters.default:
Locked-off static camera, no pan, no zoom. Deep blue ocean at night. A large glowing jellyfish pulses rhythmically in the center of frame, its bell contracting and relaxing in a steady cycle, long luminous tendrils trailing and swaying. Tiny specks of marine snow drift slowly upward through soft shafts of light. Continuous, smooth, unbroken motion throughout.

overall_soundscape: deep underwater ambience, a soft low hum, gentle muffled water movement.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

exposedParameters.label: Reference picture (optional) — call it <Picture 1> in the prompt
Loop length in frames (107 = 4.25 s, 158 = 6.4 s, 209 = 8.5 s, 260 = 10.6 s, 311 = 12.75 s) — longer takes proportionally longer
Clean sound at the loop point: 2 = on (about 1.8× slower), 1 = off (the sound can garble at the joint)
optionLabels: Off — faster, the sound can garble at the joint

exposedParameters.label: Smoothing — frame interpolation across the whole loop: 2 = 48 fps, 3 = 72 fps, 4 = 96 fps
Seed — the seed decides a lot on loops; try several
